misMetas.subtitulo: Tick the circle when you achieve a goal.

avisos.creada: Goal created! It now appears in your active goals.
avisos.cumplida: Goal achieved! It's now in your achieved goals.
avisos.oculta: Goal hidden: it will no longer show on your public profile.
avisos.visible: The goal shows on your public profile again.

tarjeta.noSeMuestra: Not shown on your public profile
tarjeta.sinCaminoCreador: This goal doesn't have a path yet. Break it into daily sub-goals so you know what to do each day.
tarjeta.sinCaminoInvitado: The goal's creator hasn't laid out the path yet. Once they add sub-goals, you'll check off your days here.
tarjeta.verRecorrido: See how you walked the path

menuTarjeta.noEditable: An achieved goal can't be edited.
menuTarjeta.soloActivas: You can only invite people to active goals.

eliminarMeta.seguro: Are you sure you want to delete {{nombre}}?
eliminarMeta.conCamino: It will be deleted along with its whole path:

cumplirMeta.texto: {{nombre}} will be marked as achieved with today's date and moved to your achieved goals. You won't be able to edit it or add sub-goals, and its sub-goals will stop being logged; their history and statistics are kept. This action can't be undone.

unirse.codigoCorto: The code has 8 characters, for example ABCD-EFGH.
unirse.texto: Enter the code shared by the person who created the goal.
